$description: Orange links on the dark surface. Emitted under the compound [data-theme="dark"][data-color="orange"] selector, because the link colour is the one accent value that cannot be theme-independent: no single ramp step clears 4.5:1 against both surfaces (orange.600 scores 5.12:1 on the light background but 3.31:1 on the dark one). The light block’s 600/700/800 becomes 400/300/200 here — the same direction dark mode already takes for status.info.fg.
